summary: Rabbits can occasionally get stuck on the edges of blocks
description:
## The Bug:

Rabbits can occasionally get stuck on the edges of blocks.

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Build the setup as shown in the attachment below. setup.png

 - Summon multiple rabbits on any of the diamond blocks.

 - Switch into survival mode and approach the rabbits so that they will run away from you.

 - Pay close attention to the behavior of the rabbits as they try to jump over blocks.

 - Take note as to whether or not rabbits can occasionally get stuck on the edges of blocks.

## Observed Behavior:

Rabbits can occasionally get stuck on the edges of blocks.

## Expected Behavior:

Rabbits would not occasionally get stuck on the edges of blocks.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Build the setup shown in `setup.png`.
2. Summon multiple rabbits on any of the diamond blocks.
3. Switch into Survival mode.
4. Approach the rabbits so that they run away from you.
5. Observe the rabbits as they try to jump over the blocks and note whether any occasionally become stuck on the edges of the blocks.

Observed Behavior: When rabbits flee across the provided block arrangement, they can occasionally become stuck at the edge or corner of a block while attempting to jump over it. The rabbit remains caught against the block instead of clearing the obstacle and continuing to move away, and may stay in this position until its movement changes or it is otherwise disturbed.
Expected Behavior: Rabbits should navigate around the block setup normally when fleeing from the player, including successfully jumping over obstacles in their path. They should not become trapped, immobilized, or remain suspended on block edges during movement. Their movement should continue naturally and consistently, allowing them to get clear of the obstacle rather than occasionally becoming stuck.
